[[File:Thon_robe_render.png|thumb|250px|Thon's robe.]]
These '''[[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]]''' once belonged to [[Thon]], a mysterious and powerful [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who trained many [[Padawan/Legends|students]], including [[Nomi Sunrider]]. Wearing these robes allowed a being to actively track thought processes faster, enhance their connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], allowing them to focus its energy, resist being stunned, and using it to leap great distances.

It was possible that the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] acquired these robes during her travels in [[3951 BBY]], in the midst of the [[First Jedi Purge]].

==Behind the scenes==
Only a character whose alignment is [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-sided]] can equip the item.
